svg.title: 1 · System overview
svg.desc: Build-time normalize script produces places.json, bundled into a static Next.js site; in the browser the trip app's reducer calls the deterministic planner and optional AI layer, which talks directly to LLM providers.
svg.text: There is no application server: the 'backend' is TypeScript that runs at build time (data cleaning) and in the browser (planner + AI).
USER'S BROWSER · ALL LOGIC RUNS HERE
no planning logic in the UI
EXTERNAL SERVICES · CALLED DIRECTLY BY THE BROWSER
